scope: Read-only independent source/methodology review; no implementation, build, test or runtime benchmark executed by this reviewer.

findings.finding: Fit Measure can retain a value after a post-operation timeout; callers previously ignored fit status.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: cold-fit, warm-disk-fit and memory-fit-hit require nonnull value and explicit PASS before dependent queries; memory hit is separately measured.

findings.finding: Cold phase wording could imply process-cold parsing/JIT despite prevalidation and earlier datasets.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: cold is explicitly absent fitted caches; prevalidation/JIT/OS and sequential process reuse are declared; query timing includes Calculate, design, expected checks and canonical JSON/hash.

findings.finding: Independent lookup-purpose rejection control was initially malformed and could pass an unrelated reader rejection.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: current control creates a valid dedicated lookup snapshot and requires the intended planning-purpose rejection message. Earlier observed receipt has INVALID_INPUT/exit2 and exact purpose message; final control execution belongs to parent.

findings.finding: Valid bounded C# exit1 result was discarded before raw per-phase evidence could be retained.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: PASS/EXIT_FAILED output is retained and strictly parsed; exit0/PASS and exit1/FAIL agreement required; incomplete timeout/output/cleanup paths fail before claimed success.

findings.finding: One timeout could mask another mathematical failure in aggregate PARTIAL classification.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: any validated benchmark FAIL is conservatively aggregate hard FAIL, retaining all raw phase outcomes.

findings.finding: Unexpected production process/output/cleanup failures were classified as partial.
findings.resolution: RESOLVED: only TIMEOUT/CANCELLED transport outcomes may be partial; other process failures set entryFailure. Decoded resource_limit/deadline_exceeded may be partial; other non-calculated outcomes fail.

confirmedProperties: The direct benchmark invokes existing FittedModelCache, unchanged RouteCalculator and CableDesignLength; decimal strings use the exact existing converter and canonical output.

Synthetic expectations include exact known segment identity set, 2*N route length, zero endpoint approaches/SECONDARY/gaps and ceiling formula; synthetic sizes beyond100 route codes claim Core capacity only.

Full route points, flags, effective category and all design strings are canonicalized without point rounding. Direct real baseline and production results compare against the copied existing preview result.

Copied source snapshot is the only real geometry mount; source runtime storage and Docker socket are not mounted in the benchmark container. Own networknone, readonly root, resource budgets and exact mount paths are guarded.
Process-group cleanup is bounded; RSS reads are explicitly sequential/non-atomic estimates, not exact coincident peaks or guaranteed lower bounds. Independent maxima are not summed.
Dedicated benchmark cache/work outputs are fresh and do not alter production runner code, production graph reuse, existing limits or frozen PF-0 fixtures.
limits: Current real input is a partial52-object26-leaf selected network; full-plant performance and engineering accuracy are not established.
Repeated queries use identical inputs; changed-query order/category/endpoint independence for a future persistent worker is not established.
PreparedModel in-memory reuse is a benchmark scenario only. Production remains one-shot; its graph is reconstructed per calculation.
Native parity, verified units/transforms/visibility/source correspondence and engineering or human acceptance are outside this review.
No latest timing or memory result is asserted by this source review; actual benchmark execution is owned separately.
